name: He Yucheng
source:
Yu-Cheng was once dedicated and soon-to-be priest, but turned to business due to family expectations. Framed by his co-worker in America he came back to Taiwan, only to receive an invitation from his best friend from high school, [url=/c40688]Wan Ji-Zin[/url], to work at his company in Indonesia.

His new life is about to start in Indonesia, but how long will his "life" be?

"Uncle doesn't want Yu-Qing to take the lonely road.
So promise me that you will tell me whenever you need help, okay?"

[Edited from [url=http://www.erotes-studio.com/MayJasmine_english/03.html]official website[/url]]
